item.title: Bank of England will probably need to raise rates next month
item.body: Chief economist Huw Pill says another rise will probably also be needed in early 2027, after rates went to 4% last month. An estimated 2.3 million homeowners must refinance next year, facing a sharp rise in mortgage payments.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📈 Bank of England will probably need to raise rates next month

Chief economist Huw Pill says another rise will probably also be needed in early 2027, after rates went to 4% last month. An estimated 2.3 million homeowners must refinance next year, facing a sharp rise in mortgage payments.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 14 November, 12:50
